requirement: Inventario search matches SKU, name, variant, external reference and the linked publication's title, brand and model
expected: Every word must appear in any order, ignoring accents and case; another store's data never matches.
preconditions: Inventory enabled; a SKU linked to a Boss DS-1 publication with a barcode as external reference.
steps: Search 'boss', 'distorsion', 'DS-1 boss' and the barcode.

requirement: The table follows the search box as the owner types
expected: After a short pause the table shows the matches without pressing Buscar; Back returns to the previous search, not to every letter.
preconditions: Inventory enabled.
steps: Type a word letter by letter, wait, then press Back.

requirement: The En revisión tile opens exactly what it counts; rejected publications have their own tile
expected: Pressing En revisión shows new publications and publications with changes in review; Rechazadas appears only when there are some and opens them.
preconditions: One pending publication, one approved with a pending change, one rejected.
steps: Press each tile and compare counts.

requirement: Inventario promises no catalog matching that does not exist
expected: No Catálogo filter; an old catalogo= link shows every SKU; the SKU page mentions the catalog only for a linked SKU.
preconditions: Inventory enabled.
steps: Open Filtrar; open /mi-cuenta/tienda/inventario?catalogo=matched; open an unlinked SKU.

requirement: −1 and +1 on a row record a store sale or a restock, each with Deshacer
expected: The available units change by one at once; Deshacer within 10 s restores them; −1 is disabled at zero.
preconditions: Inventory enabled; an active SKU with 3 units.
steps: Press −1, then Deshacer; press +1.

requirement: Undoing a movement writes a linked correction and never edits the ledger
expected: History shows the movement and "Deshecho"; the summary's sales ignore the corrected sale; a second undo is refused.
preconditions: A sale recorded by the owner.
steps: Press Deshacer, open the SKU page, check the history and the sales tile.

requirement: Undo is all or nothing and limited to the owner's own recent movements
expected: Undoing several movements fails as a whole if one is too old, already undone, from another store or would leave negative stock.
preconditions: Two movements, one aged past 15 minutes.
steps: Call undo with both ids.

requirement: Bulk threshold, category, archive and reactivate batches can be undone
expected: Deshacer restores the previous values of every SKU in the batch.
preconditions: Ten SKUs selected.
steps: Apply each bulk action, press Deshacer.

requirement: Solicitudes lists purchase requests with time, publication, SKU and buyer
expected: Signed-in buyers show their name; visitors show "Visitante sin cuenta"; the menu shows the number waiting.
preconditions: Payments pilot on; three Solicitar compra contacts, one signed in.
steps: Open Solicitudes.

requirement: Vendido records the sale and marks the request in one step
expected: Stock drops by the quantity, the sale's channel is WhatsApp / Laria, the request shows Vendida; Deshacer reverts both.
preconditions: A waiting request for a SKU with stock.
steps: Press Vendido, confirm 1 unit, then Deshacer.

requirement: Solicitudes does not exist while the payments pilot is off
expected: The page answers 404 and the menu has no Solicitudes entry.
preconditions: Pilot off.
steps: Open /mi-cuenta/tienda/solicitudes.

requirement: Ready replies name approved methods, holder and pickup details without numbers or links
expected: Each reply copies with one button; none contains a phone number, account number or URL.
preconditions: Approved Yape o Plin with holder name; pickup hours saved.
steps: Open Solicitudes, copy each reply.

requirement: A default low-stock threshold applies to new SKUs and optionally to SKUs without one
expected: New SKUs start with the default; with the option, SKUs without a threshold get it and others keep theirs.
preconditions: Some SKUs with and without a threshold.
steps: Set a default of 2 with the option, create a SKU.

requirement: The daily summary arrives once a day in Notificaciones only when there is something to report
expected: Stock bajo: N · Agotados hoy: M at 20:00 Lima, never by e-mail, never twice a day, never on a quiet day.
preconditions: Summary on; one low and one sold-out SKU.
steps: Run send_inventory_daily_summaries twice.

requirement: The reorder list shows low and sold-out SKUs with 30-day sales and a suggested quantity
expected: Suggested = max(1, max(sales 30 d, threshold + 1) − available); corrected sales don't count.
preconditions: Low and sold-out SKUs with sales.
steps: Open Reposición, download Excel and CSV.

requirement: Re-importing the filled reorder file adds what arrived after a preview
expected: Lines with unknown or archived SKUs, duplicates, formulas or non-numbers are listed and skipped; the rest is one batch with Deshacer.
preconditions: A filled reorder file with a bad row.
steps: Upload, review, press Sumar.

requirement: Agotados con interés lists sold-out SKUs by favorites and contacts
expected: Ordered by favorites plus WhatsApp contacts in 90 days; only on the unfiltered first page.
preconditions: Two sold-out published SKUs with different interest.
steps: Open Inventario.

requirement: Duplicar SKU, Crear y agregar otro and variants create SKUs without retyping
expected: Duplicate prefills everything but the code and stock; variants create one SKU per line with a suffix.
preconditions: An existing SKU.
steps: Duplicate it; create three variants.

requirement: Every SKU that matches a view can be selected and changed at once, up to 2,000
expected: The banner counts the matches; bulk actions and exports reach all of them; skipped SKUs are listed with the reason.
preconditions: A view with more SKUs than one page.
steps: Select the page, press Seleccionar los N, archive, then Deshacer.

requirement: A price campaign previews every price, can round to prices ending in 9 and can be reverted
expected: Revert restores only SKUs whose price is still the campaign's; repeating the revert replays its result.
preconditions: Ten guitars with prices.
steps: Start −15% on Guitarras with rounding, apply, change one price, revert.

requirement: Exportar esta vista downloads exactly the view, optionally with publication fields
expected: The file has the view's SKUs in its order; the publication option adds title, price, condition, city and description.
preconditions: A filtered view.
steps: Download Excel, CSV and Excel with publication.

requirement: Saved views appear as chips and can be deleted
expected: Four built-in views plus up to 12 of the store's; a name is unique per store.
preconditions: Inventory enabled.
steps: Filter, press Guardar vista, reopen, delete.

requirement: Keyboard shortcuts work and never fire while typing
expected: /, n, v, r, a, ? and Ctrl/Cmd+K do what the help lists; every action also has a button.
preconditions: Desktop browser.
steps: Press each shortcut, then type them in a field.

requirement: The list shows its range with Anterior and Siguiente, and the SKU page keeps the position
expected: 51–100 de 312; the SKU page shows "N de M" with Anterior and Siguiente; the breadcrumb returns to the same page.
preconditions: More than 50 SKUs.
steps: Go to page 2, open a SKU, go next, return.

requirement: A SKU's category can be set on its page and in bulk
expected: Invalid categories are refused; a linked publication keeps its own category.
preconditions: An unlinked SKU.
steps: Set a category on the SKU page and in bulk.

requirement: Solicitar compra asks for a quantity up to what is available without showing stock
expected: The stepper stops at available units or 10; the message says the quantity; the page never shows the count.
preconditions: Pilot on; a publication with 16 units.
steps: Press + until it stops, then Solicitar compra.

requirement: Mostrador sells several items by camera, typing or USB scanner in one sale
expected: Each code adds a unit, never beyond stock; the sale is one movement per SKU with Deshacer for 10 s.
preconditions: Inventory enabled; SKUs with barcodes as external reference.
steps: Scan or type two codes, register the sale, press Deshacer.

requirement: Sales made offline wait on the device and are sent when the connection returns
expected: The queue shows waiting sales; on reconnect they're recorded once (same key); a refused sale stays with its reason.
preconditions: Mostrador open.
steps: Go offline, sell, go online.
